name: RCCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's own top singles title, held by Clutch into its one surviving pay-per-view main event — a bloody Taipei Death Match against the promotion's Hardcore-billed champion, Maverick, that ended without a fall when both men left the cage and traded belts instead.

name: RCCW World Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on the federation's one surviving pay-per-view when Jason Creed pinned the reigning champion, Quezzy, with a standing corkscrew leg whip; a fellow wrestler's own later tally credits a third holder within weeks, though no card documenting that change survives.

name: RCCW World Television Championship
epitaph: Defended once in this record, in a match between L-Mo and Carnage that a outside interference cut short as a no contest, leaving the title's holder unchanged.

name: RCCW World Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Left the federation with its own champion, Piston, who attacked his challenger before the bell of its one surviving defense and walked out of the promotion with the belt.

name: RCCW Women's World Championship
epitaph: Retired by the federation's own president the same night its last defense — a double countout between Heroine and Freefall — left its lineage unresolved.

name: RCCW European Championship
epitaph: Left the federation when its own champion, Octane, announced his retirement in the ring and walked out with the belt rather than defend it.
